caption_L2L3: passenger car production increased rapidly by around 50% from 40,000,000 to 60,000,000 in the 10 year period from 2000 to 2010 with a significant dip around 2008 before starting to continue its increase peaking in 2017 before a pattern of decline which was continuing up until 2020 (the data in the current chart).
